title: Replace an individual property licence
summary: You can apply for a free replacement of a damaged, lost, or stolen individual property licence at a Service NSW Centre or by email.
intro:
If you hold an individual property licence and it has been damaged, lost or stolen, you can apply for a free replacement licence at a Service NSW Centre or by email.

To check your property licence number and details visit Verify NSW.
what_you_need: The type of licence (individual property licence)
Visit a service centre or email propertylicensing@customerservice.nsw.gov.au

faqs.q: How can I check my property licence number and details?
faqs.a: You can check your property licence number and details by visiting Verify NSW.

faqs.q: How do I replace my individual property licence?
faqs.a: You can apply for a free replacement licence by visiting a Service NSW Centre or by emailing propertylicensing@customerservice.nsw.gov.au.
